# FG-INT-0011

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`webhook-delivery`](../../ops/runbooks/webhook-delivery.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `fifty_consecutive_failures_disable_the_webhook` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Webhook が失敗し続けたので、自動で無効にしました。受信先を直してから、もう一度有効にしてください。
- en: A webhook kept failing and was disabled automatically. Fix the receiver, then enable it again.
- id: Webhook terus gagal sehingga dinonaktifkan secara otomatis. Perbaiki penerima, lalu aktifkan kembali.

## 原因 (cause)

A webhook's delivery attempts failed 50 times in a row (`reason=failures`) or kept failing without a success for 24 hours (`reason=failing_24h`; ADR-0016 §8). forge disabled it (`webhooks.enabled = false`, `disabled_reason`), wrote the `webhook.disabled` audit row on the project as the system and published the `webhook.disabled` event (maintainer class: the hook point a notification, or another webhook naming the type, can follow). Its pending deliveries end as `skipped` (`webhook_disabled`); new events are not recorded for it until a Maintainer enables it again.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `webhook_id`, `project_id`, `reason`, `failures` and `failing_since` (RFC 3339, UTC). `gstn webhook view <webhook_id> --project <id>` shows `enabled`, `disabled_reason` and `consecutive_failures`; the deliveries show the last statuses and reasons. SELECT action, details, occurred_at FROM forge.audit_log WHERE action = 'webhook.disabled' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook webhook-delivery: fix the receiver, then enable the webhook (`gstn webhook update <webhook_id> --project <id> --enable`, a Maintainer; enabling resets the failure count) and redeliver the deliveries that matter, or let the receiver catch up from the integration feed.
